description: Na₅CuS₄(NO₆)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅4 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.69 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one S and five O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 3.22 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.51 Å. There are two inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form edge-sharing CuS₄ tetrahedra. All Cu-S bond lengths are 2.35 Å. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form edge-sharing CuS₄ tetrahedra. All Cu-S bond lengths are 2.35 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and two longer (1.27 Å) N-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Cu, and one S atom. The S-S bond length is 2.08 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one S and three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.49 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃S tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one N atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom.
